lore.bio:
Mirage is the kind of guy who likes to stand out. The youngest of four brothers, he perfected the art of fooling around to get attention. The one thing he took seriously was Holo-Pilot technology: introduced to the illusion-creating tech by his engineer mother, he poured over the mechanisms and learned all he could about them. Even when his brothers went MIA during the Outlands’ Civil War, Mirage and his mother continued to develop holo devices, and the work brought them closer.
While working as a bartender to make ends meet, Mirage heard amazing stories from his patrons about the Apex Games and the wealth and glory that came with victory. As good as both of those sounded, he knew he couldn’t risk leaving his mother childless – until she gave him a set of customized holo devices and told him to follow his dream. Mirage is now the life of the Apex Games, outwitting opponents and charming audiences across the Outlands, in front of cameras for the world - and his mother - to see.

For more information on Mirage's story, see Mirage (character).

passive.name: Now You See Me...
passive.description: Automatically cloak when using Respawn Beacons or healing consumable items. Spawn a decoy and cloak when downed.

tactical.name: Psyche Out
tactical.description: Send out a holographic decoy to confuse the enemy. The enemy who shoots it will be tracked with a marker.

ultimate.name: Life of the Party
ultimate.description: Mirage deploys a team of controllable decoys to distract enemies.

tactics.playstyle: The illusionist of chaos. Mirage's goal is to sow doubt in the opponent's mind. Close-range 1v1 fights are his strong suit, using his clones to buy those crucial split seconds needed for victory.

left.name: Renaissance Man
left.description: Can now interact with all other Classes’ world interactions: Assault Bins, Care Package scans, Survey Beacons, and Ring Consoles. (Mirage and his team will ONLY gain EVO for these interactions if the squad also has a member of that class.)

right.name: Boozle-Eye
right.description: Successful Bamboozles also highlight enemies for a short time.

left.name: Me Two
left.description: Gain a Decoy charge (can have 2 decoys out at once).

right.name: Bamboozle Bonus
right.description: Refreshes Tactical cooldown on successful Bamboozles.
